journal_lines: Petals drifting down without any wind.
Wood pale and close-grained. Smells faintly sweet.
This place makes time feel very long.
A family of rabbits under a fallen log. Worked around them.
Pink in the canopy, pink on the ground, pink in the air. Could not tell where the tree ended.
A grove so quiet it felt like the world had stopped to listen. Worked very quietly inside it.
Petals settled on the bag as I worked. Carried some home by accident.
The smell of the wood took the edge off everything. Did not mind staying longer.
A bee in a fallen blossom, unconscious of the season ending. Let it be.
Cut a single trunk and a thousand petals fell. An apology, maybe.
